calculate_mm_tokens: calculate the total number of multimodal tokens needed given max images and tokens per image
add_image_tokens: add extra image placeholder tokens to text tokens for multimodal Gemma model inference
insert_token_sequence: insert a sequence of tokens at every occurrence of a target token in a batch
merge_embeddings: merge text embeddings with vision embeddings using a boolean mask to place vision tokens
remove_mm_logits: remove multimodal logits from model output to recover the original text-only logit sequence
